source: FES Direct(SHETL) rows carry no site: a representative point (OSGB36 m) inside the SHETL licence area (north of B4); their side is known only on known_boundaries, the boundaries the whole SHETL area lies on one side of (judgement, CP30 locational audit 15 Oct 2026); region = the ES5 region of the licence area

FES Direct(SPTL) rows carry no site: a representative point (OSGB36 m) inside the SPTL licence area (between B4 and B6); side known only on known_boundaries (the SPTL area straddles B5); judgement, CP30 locational audit 15 Oct 2026; region = the ES5 region of the licence area

FES Direct(NGET) rows carry no site: a representative point (OSGB36 m) in England and Wales; side known only on the Scottish boundaries B0-B6 (the NGET area lies wholly south of them); judgement, CP30 locational audit 15 Oct 2026; region unlocated (allowed in any England and Wales region)
